review_candidates.title: Director, IT Infrastructure
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role is responsible for building and maturing the infrastructure function, establishing technical standards and governance, leading infrastructure modernization, and ensuring the platforms supporting the organization are secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective. Duties And Responsibilities Infrastructure & Cloud Own enterprise network and connectivity infrastructure, including routing, switching, firewalls, wireless, and ISP/circuit relationships. Own the Hyper-V virtualization enviro
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Reporting to the VP, Corporate Systems & IT, the Director owns infrastructure as a distinct discipline and provides both strategic direction and hands-on technical leadership. Partner with Cybersecurity on identity, access, and security policy requirements. Partner with Cybersecurity on backup security requirements, Active Directory hardening, and incident response. Provide hands-on technical leadership and participate directly in troubleshooting, architecture, and implementation when required. Deep, current, hands-on experience administering Microsoft Azure infrastructure at production scale, including compute, storage, networking, and governance controls. Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot and zero-touch device provisioning. Ability and willingness to remain hands-on and engage directly with infrastructure technologies when required.
